Dear

Please refer to the subject; it is advised to provide following information for onward submission to SBP:

It is advised to provide the LIBOR setting date for each repayment date. Further, please revise the repayment
schedule according to terms of the loan as the interest payments cannot be ascertained at this time as the interest
rate under the subject agreement is variable.

Further, it is informed that LIBOR is used for the currencies for which the LIBOR issuing authorities issue the LIBOR
rate and in case of AED, no such rate is issued by the same. Therefore, provide the relevant rate or explain the
following clause of the loan agreement

“Each instalment shall be calculated in AED and any forex gain or loss shall be borne by the borrower”

Moreover, please provide the details of the shareholding of Deevar Developers and an undertaking that the Director of
Bayut Web Publishing is a non­resident.
